evidence.reason: The fixture creates a temporary repository, changes the committer identity to fixture@example.invalid, and commits at line 94 without disabling inherited commit.gpgSign. When a developer or runner has global commit.gpgSign=true and no signing key for that fixture identity, git commit fails and DeployTests setUp errors. A repository-local commit.gpgSign=false before the first commit is a small, compatible test-isolation fix.
